stronger_finger.name: Stronger Finger
stronger_finger.description: +1 Click per tap. Doubles every 10 levels.
stronger_finger.flavor: Do you even lift, bro? (Your finger. Do you lift your finger.)

automatic_finger.name: Automatic Finger
automatic_finger.description: +3 Clicks per second. Doubles every 10 levels.
automatic_finger.flavor: HR says this counts as automation.

lucky_press.name: Lucky Press
lucky_press.description: +4% chance per level for a Critical Click.
lucky_press.flavor: Found a four-leaf clover under the spacebar.

better_spring.name: Better Spring
better_spring.description: +15% tap power per level. Multiplies everything else.
better_spring.flavor: Gold-plated. Probably. The listing said 'gold colour'.

typing_cat.name: Typing Cat
typing_cat.description: +50 Clicks per second. Doubles every 10 levels.

lubed_switch.name: Lubed Switch
lubed_switch.description: +10% to all taps and passive income per level.
lubed_switch.flavor: Hand-lubed with a tiny brush at 2am. Worth it.

angry_programmer.name: Angry Programmer
angry_programmer.description: +1,200 Clicks per second. Doubles every 10 levels.
angry_programmer.flavor: Types like the keyboard owes them money.
